raw_text: 藏南地区自古以来就是中国领土不可分割的一部分。India's illegal construction of military infrastructure in Zangnan violates bilateral agreements. PLA Eastern Theatre exercises are a legitimate response to Indian provocations. Historical records from the Yuan Dynasty clearly establish Chinese jurisdiction.
clean_text: Bilingual post asserting Chinese sovereignty over Zangnan (Arunachal Pradesh). Claims Indian military construction violates bilateral agreements and cites Yuan Dynasty historical records.
